3.why: Bounds checks need the row count.

4.why: Bounds checks need the column count.

5.why: Each cell needs a flag: unvisited, queued, or done.

6.happening: We build the state grid row by row.
6.invariant: state fills to match the grid.

7.happening: We add a row of zero (unvisited) flags.
7.why: No cell has been seen yet.

8.happening: We start the largest area at 0.
8.why: No island has been measured yet.
8.invariant: best is the largest island area so far.

9.happening: There is no current cell yet.
9.why: cur_r is set only during a flood.

10.happening: There is no current column yet.
10.why: cur_c is set only during a flood.

11.happening: We list the four orthogonal directions.
11.why: Islands connect through edges, not diagonals.

12.happening: We scan row {sr} for a starting cell.
12.why: Every land cell belongs to some island.

13.why: We check each cell as a possible island start.
13.invariant: The scan covers the whole grid.

14.happening: Cell ({sr},{sc}) is unvisited land — start a flood.
14.why: Each island is flooded once from its first-found cell.
14.invariant: A flood begins only from fresh land.

14.happening: Cell ({sr},{sc}) is water or already visited — skip it.
14.why: Only new land starts a new island.
14.invariant: Visited land and water are not re-flooded.

15.happening: We start this island's area at 0.
15.why: Cells are counted as the queue processes them.
15.invariant: area counts fully-visited cells of this island.

16.happening: We create an empty BFS queue.
16.why: It holds the frontier of cells to visit.

17.happening: We seed the queue with the start cell.
17.why: The flood spreads outward from here.
17.invariant: The queue always has the frontier.

18.happening: We mark the start cell as queued.
18.why: So it is never enqueued twice.

19.happening: The queue still has {len(queue)} cell(s) to process.
19.why: BFS continues until the frontier empties.
19.invariant: Every queued cell will be counted.

19.happening: The queue is empty — this island is fully flooded.

20.happening: We take the front cell off the queue.
20.why: BFS processes cells in the order they were found.

21.why: To mark and expand from this cell.
21.invariant: cur_r is the current cell's row.

22.why: To mark and expand from this cell.
22.invariant: cur_c is the current cell's column.

23.why: It is now counted and will not be revisited.

24.happening: We count this cell, area becomes {area} + 1.
24.why: Each visited land cell adds to the island's area.
24.invariant: area equals the visited cells of this island.

25.happening: We look at the four neighbours of the current cell.

26.why: We must check it is a valid land cell.

27.why: We must check it is a valid land cell.

28.happening: We test if ({nr},{nc}) is in-bounds, land, and unvisited.
28.why: Only such neighbours belong to this island.
28.invariant: Out-of-bounds, water, and visited cells are rejected.

29.why: So it is not enqueued twice.

30.happening: We add the neighbour to the queue.
30.why: It will be counted and expanded later.

31.happening: This island's area {area} beats the best {best}.
31.invariant: best is the maximum area seen.

31.happening: This island's area {area} does not beat best {best}.

32.invariant: best is the largest island so far.

33.happening: We clear the current-cell row between islands.
33.why: So no cell shows as current while scanning.

34.happening: We clear the current-cell column between islands.
34.why: So no cell shows as current while scanning.

35.happening: We return the largest island area {best}.
35.why: Every island has been flooded and measured.
35.invariant: best is the maximum over all islands.

init.happening: Build the visited grid and setup.

loop.happening: Scan for a start or flood the frontier.
loop.why: Every land cell is visited once.

check.happening: Test a start cell, a neighbour, or a new best.
check.why: These gate flooding and the answer.

update.happening: Count a cell, enqueue a neighbour, or record a best.
update.why: The island grows and the best is tracked.
update.invariant: State reflects the flood so far.

move.happening: Dequeue a cell or compute a neighbour.
